evals.prompt: I'm starting a new Vite + React + TypeScript app and I want to use myui. Walk me through the full setup — the path alias config, adding the registry, and installing the Select component.
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step setup instructions: tsconfig.json @/ alias, vite.config.ts alias, full components.json (no tailwind fields), then the shadcn CLI add command for select. Mention DirectionProvider for RTL.

assertions.text: Includes the correct myui registry URL (idos350.github.io/myui) in components.json
Shows a complete components.json with aliases block (not just the registries key)
Shows correct shadcn CLI add command for select (@myui/select)

evals.prompt: My app uses myui and I need to change the brand color from blue to a warm orange. What's the right way to do this?
evals.expected_output: Edit src/theme/colors.scss directly to change --color-primary and related tokens. Show OKLCH values. Handle dark mode variant too.

assertions.text: Directs the user to edit src/theme/colors.scss
Includes a dark mode variant (data-theme='dark' block or equivalent)

evals.prompt: I added a myui Select to my app and it works, but I realized I'm importing from the primitives file. My linter is also flagging a relative import. Can you fix my import?
evals.expected_output: Replace import from primitives.ts with import from Select.tsx using @/ alias. Explain that primitives.ts is reserved for advanced composition, not normal usage.

assertions.text: Explains primitives.ts is for internal/advanced use, not general imports
Does not recommend importing from primitives.ts for normal usage

evals.prompt: I want to add a dark/light mode toggle to my myui app. How do I set up the ThemeProvider and wire up a toggle button?
evals.expected_output: Wrap app in ThemeProvider from @/theme/useTheme. Show useTheme() with setTheme/resolved. Toggle button example. Mention data-theme or localStorage.

assertions.text: Mentions resolved property or data-theme attribute

evals.prompt: I've customized the Button component in my app (rounded corners, different padding). Now myui released a new version of Button. How do I update without losing my changes?
evals.expected_output: Use --diff flag first to preview changes, check CHANGELOG.md to understand what changed, then run shadcn add to apply. Help the user re-apply their local customizations after.

assertions.text: Uses the --diff flag to preview changes before overwriting
Gives the shadcn add @myui/button command to apply the update
Advises reviewing/re-applying local customizations after the update
